description: Election Commission - Two members have Vacated their Office of member of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes matters concerning electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials' status.
